# Following the trace

<figure class="journey-figure journey-screen" markdown="1">
![](../../img/journey/screens/20261016T094945Z-trace_iop_clkgate.png){ .journey-capture }
<figcaption>What the phone's screen showed in this run (evidence folder [`20261016T094945Z-trace_iop_clkgate`](https://github.com/SebE585/trognon/tree/main/evidence/20261016T094945Z-trace_iop_clkgate)). The image is rebuilt from the payload's own screen buffer, not photographed.</figcaption>
</figure>

How sure we are: <span class="tag tag-device">DEVICE</span>

Start from what the phone answered. Our code read the gate array at position `0x27` and the console shows
`GATE+27  0000000F`. That reading is real: the evidence folder holds it.

What it shows: that gate reads as on. What it does not show: which block that gate feeds. A reading carries no label.

Now sheet 1, the device tree: its entry for the coprocessor lists `0x27`. Side by side, the two sheets seem to line up.
Both use the same number. Nothing, so far, says they count gates the same way.
